# Technext24

> > Technext24 is Nigeria's premier tech events platform connecting thousands of innovators, entrepreneurs, and brands across Africa's growing digital ecosystem.

Technext24 operates a comprehensive events platform that brings together Nigeria's tech community through sponsorship opportunities, networking events, and experiential marketing initiatives. The platform serves as a central hub for brand positioning within Africa's startup and youth tech sectors.

- Technext Events
- Nigeria tech ecosystem
- Event sponsorship
- Brand positioning
- Networking events
- Nigerian startups
- Youth marketing
- Millennials & GenZ
- Hackathon
- Technext Convo
- Technext Tour & Tournament

- Lagos tech community
- Tech ecosystem
- Event calendar

## Events & Sponsorship

- [Technext Events](https://events.technext24.com): Technext Events platform for brand sponsorship, networking with 7000+ attendees in Nigeria's tech ecosystem.
